-------------------------DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCE----------------------------------
WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(38,10),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),TRAN_DATE_BAL)),0) TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN)),0) TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),TS_CNT)),0) TS_CNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),VALUE_DATE_BAL)),0) VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN)),0) VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM

)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT REPLACE(H,'F-','') COUNT_src
, TRAN_DATE_BAL TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
, TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
, TS_CNT TS_CNT_src
, VALUE_DATE_BAL VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
, VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src

, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_DEP_EODACCOUNTBALANCEFULL WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
, TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
, VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
, VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
, TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
, TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
, TS_CNT_src
, VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
, VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src

, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)

INSERT INTO [d360].[HASH_LOG_TBL]
SELECT 
FILE_NAME
,DATE
,insert_dttm
,REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') METRICS
,SRC
,TGT 

FROM
(
SELECT CAST(COUNT_SRC AS numeric(38,10)) COUNT_SRC
,CAST(COUNT_TGT AS numeric(38,10)) COUNT_TGT
,CAST(TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt AS numeric(38,10)) TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
,CAST(TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt AS numeric(38,10)) TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
,CAST(TS_CNT_tgt AS numeric(38,10)) TS_CNT_tgt
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt AS numeric(38,10)) VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt AS numeric(38,10)) VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
,CAST(TRAN_DATE_BAL_src AS numeric(38,10)) TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
,CAST(TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src AS numeric(38,10)) TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
,CAST(TS_CNT_src AS numeric(38,10)) TS_CNT_src
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_BAL_src AS numeric(38,10)) VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
,CAST(VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src AS numeric(38,10)) VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
,FILE_NAME
,INSERT_DTTM
,[DATE]
FROM CTE12
) pvt

UNPIVOT
(
SRC FOR METRICS IN (COUNT_SRC
, TRAN_DATE_BAL_src
, TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
, TS_CNT_src
, VALUE_DATE_BAL_src
, VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_src
 )
) pvt1

UNPIVOT
(
TGT For METRICS2 IN (COUNT_TGT
, TRAN_DATE_BAL_tgt
, TRAN_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
, TS_CNT_tgt
, VALUE_DATE_BAL_tgt
, VALUE_DATE_TOT_TRAN_tgt
 )
) pvt2
 
WHERE REPLACE(METRICS,'_SRC','') = REPLACE(METRICS2,'_TGT','');

WITH CTE1 
AS(
SELECT convert(numeric(38,10),COUNT(*)) COUNT_tgt
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL)),0) ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_tgt   
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL)),0) ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_tgt 
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL)),0) PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_tgt 
, isnull(sum(convert(numeric(38,10),PREVIOUS_CURRBAL)),0) PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_tgt   
 
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM 
FROM d360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL WHERE H = 'D'
GROUP BY FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM
 
)
,
CTE2 AS (
SELECT cast(REPLACE(TRIM(H),'F-','') AS numeric(38,10)) COUNT_src
, cast(ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL AS numeric(38,10)) ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_src
, cast(ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL AS numeric(38,10)) ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_src
, cast(PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL AS numeric(38,10)) PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_src
, cast(PREVIOUS_CURRBAL AS numeric(38,10)) PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_src
 
, FILE_NAME, INSERT_DTTM FROM d360.STG_DEP_YTDDEPAGGRBALANCESFULL WHERE H <> 'D'
)
,
CTE12 as (
SELECT COUNT_SRC, COUNT_TGT
, ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_tgt
, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_tgt
, PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_tgt
, PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_tgt
, ACCUMULATED_CLEARBAL_src
, ACCUMULATED_CURRBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CLEARBAL_src
, PREVIOUS_CURRBAL_src
 
, A.FILE_NAME, A.INSERT_DTTM, CONVERT(DATE,(left(right(A.FILE_NAME, 12),8))) DATE FROM CTE1 A
JOIN CTE2 B ON A.FILE_NAME = B.FILE_NAME AND A.INSERT_DTTM = B.INSERT_DTTM
)
select * into #CTE12 from CTE12;
